lines.text: Since they were raised with Christ, believers are to set their minds on things above, where Christ is seated.
Believers died, their life is hidden with Moses in God, and when Christ appears they will appear with Him in glory.
Believers must put to death greed, which is idolatry, and put aside anger, rage, malice, slander, and filthy language.
They took off the old self and put on the new, where there is no barbarian, Philistine, slave, or free.
As God's elect, they are to clothe themselves with compassion and put on love, the bond of perfect unity.
